sleep.title: Sofitel Athens Airport
sleep.hint: 2 minutes on foot from the airport
sleep.text: Sofitel Athens Airport is a 2-minute walk from Athens International Airport. The hotel has an indoor pool, fitness centre, restaurant, bar and Wi-Fi; check-in starts at 13:00 and check-out is by 11:00.

wifi.title: Wi‑Fi
wifi.text: The terminal offers the free ATH Free Wifi network. Select Internet Access on the connection page: each session lasts 120 minutes. You can then reconnect for free.

storage.title: Left luggage
storage.text: CARE4BAG is in the public arrivals area at exit 1 and is open 24 hours. You can leave luggage, boxes and sports equipment here.
